workload.name: TypeScript: opencode
workload.description: Cold clone, bun install and typecheck of anomalyco/opencode, at the commit and Bun version ComputeSDK's DAX sandbox benchmark uses. Unlike DAX, typecheck runs `turbo typecheck --concurrency=4` on every runner, whatever its size: turbo's default parallelism needs more than 16 GB and gets OOM-killed on runners without swap. Totals are therefore not directly comparable with DAX.
workload.toolchain: bun 1.3.14, node-gyp 12.4.0 on PATH (native modules built on every runner)
